title: Dinotofu special characters
note: Prepared data file. Special dates are now configured for protected playable identities. Matt (PRO) stays non-playable, but can still appear as a special arena opponent.

characters.name: Matt (PRO)
characters.description: Direct reference to Matt from Wii Sports. Separate non-playable reference AI, no class specialty, globally better in every class.
characters.appearsThrough: Dedicated Matt (PRO) option, not manual opponent creation.
characters.personality: Reference opponent; also part of special arena draw. No native class speciality, globally better in every class.

characters.name: Hazak
characters.description: Protected special identity. Dark elf assassin.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Dark, efficient assassin. Direct, arrogant, focused on winning.

characters.name: Mattzelda
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.

characters.name: Aoi
characters.description: Future flame mage, kitsune summoner, also uses a katana.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Shy kitsune caster, but fiercely protects her incantations.

characters.name: Kanadé
characters.description: Random zodiac spell mage linked to the 13 zodiac signs.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Rageful complainer, complains about everything but remains determined.

characters.name: Fail
characters.description: Mad fairy mage with many spell types and some unique spells.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Experiments, improves, and eradicates threats in the most spectacular way possible.

characters.name: Trexof
characters.description: Human assassin with slight bonuses; main beta tester.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Human assassin, main beta tester, focused and dangerous.

characters.name: Skuro
characters.description: Tank with heavy two-handed sword. Low accuracy, huge damage.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Greedy for clean cuts and decapitation. Loves when his blade enters matter.

characters.name: Sanctus
characters.description: Protection and hindrance specialist using beliefs linked to a god of light.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Protector and hindrance specialist. Defends himself if someone blocks his path.

characters.name: Hestia
characters.description: Almost everything is null except magic. Magic grows stronger every use, hit or miss. Starts with max-level protection dome.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Fearful mage. Charges in with eyes closed because she is scared, and would avoid combat if possible.

characters.name: Fire Flight
characters.description: Basic stats, but under 50% HP gains much better dodge and almost guaranteed critical hits.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Commander and leader. Struggles to understand that humans and semi-humans can be hostile. Likes projectile rain.

characters.name: Louis
characters.description: Precise artificer using multiple projectiles per attack.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
characters.personality: Naive, friendly artificer looking for friends.

characters.name: Henrique
characters.description: Special knight able to come back to life once in future systems. Charges straight into danger.
characters.personality: Frontal knight. Rushes into battle and can return once from death later.
characters.appearsThrough: Arena random draw only, unless unlocked as a protected playable identity with special date.
